title: Connecting Scholarship Dollars to Opportunity with Blackbaud Financial Aid Management™
summary: As education funding models evolve, scholarship granting organizations are playing an increasingly important role. Blackbaud Financial Aid Management™ is evolving to support that work.
body_markdown:
As education funding models evolve, scholarship granting organizations are playing an increasingly important role in connecting families with educational opportunities. We’re evolving Blackbaud Financial Aid Management™ to help support that work.


For families navigating K–12 education, access to scholarship funding can make a meaningful difference. But behind each scholarship is a complex process involving the organization administering the funds, the family receiving an award, the school the student attends and the financial systems responsible for accounting for those dollars.


At Blackbaud, we see an opportunity to make that experience more connected.


Beginning at the end of 2026 and continuing into early 2027, we plan to expand Blackbaud Financial Aid Management to support scholarship granting organizations (SGOs) and other organizations administering K–12 scholarship programs. Additional capabilities are expected to evolve alongside the market and changing requirements.


“Families, scholarship organizations, schools, and their financial systems shouldn’t have to operate in isolation,” said Mark Davis, vice president and general manager of education products, Blackbaud. “Scholarship granting organizations have an opportunity to open doors for students, and we want to give them a flexible foundation that starts with awarding and grows with them, one that adapts as state and federal requirements take shape.”


##### Building on a Foundation for Financial Aid


Financial Aid Management already supports both need- and non-need-based awards, third-party scholarships, separate award budgets, allocation and disbursement tracking, batch awarding and reallocation of unaccepted awards.


We plan to build on that foundation with functionality designed around the needs of SGOs, including:


- Connecting scholarship awards with participating schools selected by students, creating a stronger handoff between SGOs and schools


- Multi-school administration


- Greater visibility and controls across organizations


- Clearer fund and award reporting


The goal is to create a more connected scholarship experience while giving organizations flexibility to begin with the capabilities they need and grow over time.


##### Adapting to a Changing Education Funding Landscape


There is no single model for administering education funding. State-funded programs can differ significantly in their eligibility requirements, application processes, administration and how funds ultimately reach schools.


That means flexibility matters.


We’re shaping Financial Aid Management to support state-specific calculations, application and review workflows and reconciliation requirements as these models develop. We’re also closely monitoring emerging federal requirements. With formal guidance still a factor in determining the workflows SGOs and schools will need, our approach is intentionally designed to adapt.


That ability to evolve is consistent with Blackbaud’s broader approach to technology for social impact. Across our solutions, we’re investing in connected experiences and purpose-built innovation, including Blackbaud AI, to help organizations reduce administrative friction and focus more of their capacity on their missions.


##### Connecting the Journey From Donor Support to Student Opportunity


For an SGO, administering a scholarship is only one part of the story. These organizations need to raise scholarship dollars, award those funds to students and account for how the money is used.


Our vision is an approach that supports the full lifecycle of SGO Financial Aid Management. Blackbaud is exploring a future roadmap that includes:


- **Raising Funds:** Using Blackbaud Raiser’s Edge NXT® to support SGO donor management and fundraising.


- **Awarding Scholarships:** Using Blackbaud Financial Aid Management to support scholarship applications, eligibility review and awards.


- **Accounting:** Using Blackbaud Financial Edge NXT® as an add-on for fund accounting, reconciliation and financial reporting.


The goal is to enable organizations to start with scholarship administration and add capabilities as their needs grow. With a flexible foundation that can connect people, organizations and systems, SGOs and the families they support can turn scholarship dollars into educational opportunities.

*This is a roadmap. Packaging, pricing, availability and connections among these solutions remain in development.*
